Identifying a global polynomial conjugacy and two independent first integrals yields all-leaf cusp/fold geometry, sharp slow relaxation, and a complete stationary-measure/heteroclinic description not implied by the original accessible chaotic parameter analysis; it enables exact comparison of the integrable boundary with nonzero-parameter behavior without claiming that perturbative behavior is solved.
